manifest.name: 相册
manifest.description: 电脑与 ATOM 同步的私有相册：原图、收藏、全屏相框，以及文字生图和照片风格改写。

files.index.html: <!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>相册</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css"></head><body><main id="root" aria-live="polite"></main><script src="app.js"></script></body></html>
files.style.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;background:var(--bg,#f5f5f7);color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}button,input,textarea{font:inherit}button{border:0;border-radius:12px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 14px;background:var(--card,#fff);color:var(--accent,#007aff);cursor:pointer;font-weight:550}button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#007aff);outline-offset:2px}.primary{background:var(--accent,#007aff);color:white}.quiet{background:transparent}.danger{color:#d93b42}h1,h2,p{margin:0}h1{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-1px}h2{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.5px}small,.muted{color:var(--muted,#86868b)}#root{height:100%;width:100%}.album{height:100%;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;overflow:hidden}header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-shrink:0}.heading p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#86868b);margin-top:4px}.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;align-self:flex-start;padding:3px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--line,#e8e8ed);flex-shrink:0}.tabs button{min-height:32px;padding:5px 15px;font-size:13px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#86868b)}.tabs button.on{background:var(--card,#fff);color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #00000010}.grid{flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.photo{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:13px;background:var(--line,#e5e5ea)}.photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.photo .heart,.photo .ai{position:absolute;bottom:7px;right:8px;color:white;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #000a;font-size:16px}.photo .ai{left:8px;right:auto;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.8px}.pager{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:12px;min-height:32px;flex-shrink:0}.pager button{min-height:30px;padding:4px 11px}.empty{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;gap:12px}.empty img{width:65px;height:65px;opacity:.55}.empty p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted,#86868b)}.notice{font-size:12px;color:#b75430;line-height:1.5;background:var(--card,#fff);padding:10px;border-radius:12px;flex-shrink:0}.feedback{height:20px;flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#86868b);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.feedback.error{color:#bd463e}.studio{flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px}.reference{min-height:0;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card,#fff);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative}.reference img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain}.reference .reference-label{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:14px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#0009;color:white;font-size:12px}.reference .empty img{width:70px;height:70px}.create-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;gap:14px}.style-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.style-choice{font-size:13px;min-height:55px;padding:10px 4px;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}.style-choice.selected{color:white;background:var(--accent,#007aff)}textarea{flex:1;min-height:65px;resize:none;border:0;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;color:inherit;background:var(--card,#fff);outline:none;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}.privacy{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#86868b);line-height:1.6}.create-form>.primary{flex-shrink:0}.job-art{width:90px;height:90px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}.ring{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--line,#ddd);border-top-color:var(--accent,#007aff);animation:turn 2s linear infinite}.job-list{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.job-row{padding:14px;background:var(--card,#fff);border-radius:16px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}.job-row>div{flex:1;min-width:0}.job-row strong{font-size:14px;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.job-row p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#86868b);margin-top:5px}.viewer{position:relative;height:100%;width:100%;background:#08090c;color:white;overflow:hidden;touch-action:pan-y}.viewer>.picture{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}.viewer .top,.viewer .bottom{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px;gap:10px;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(#0009,transparent);transition:opacity .25s}.viewer .bottom{bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#000a);justify-content:center}.viewer .top{top:0}.viewer button{color:white;background:#ffffff24;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}.viewer .caption{min-width:0;flex:1;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;text-align:center}.viewer.clean .top,.viewer.clean .bottom{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}.viewer .view-error{position:absolute;top:50%;left:15%;right:15%;text-align:center;background:#202127;padding:18px;border-radius:14px;color:white}.viewer .view-error button{margin-top:8px}.compare img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}.compare .after{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 50%)}.compare input{position:absolute;left:10%;width:80%;bottom:70px;z-index:2}.compare .labels{position:absolute;top:65px;left:22px;right:22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;text-shadow:0 1px 4px black}.confirm{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:5;background:#0008;padding:22px}.confirm>div{padding:22px;background:var(--card,#fff);color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);border-radius:22px;max-width:360px}.confirm p{margin:10px 0 18px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}.confirm .actions{justify-content:flex-end}.visually-hidden{display:none!important}@keyframes turn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@media(max-width:600px){.album{padding:16px 18px;gap:9px}h1{font-size:25px}.heading p{font-size:11px}.actions{gap:6px}button{padding:7px 12px;min-height:36px}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.tabs button{font-size:12px;min-height:28px;padding:4px 13px}.pager{min-height:26px}.pager button{min-height:26px;font-size:12px}.feedback{height:16px;font-size:11px}.studio{grid-template-columns:115px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}.reference{border-radius:16px}.reference .reference-label{left:7px;bottom:8px;font-size:10px;padding:4px 6px}.reference .empty{padding:8px}.reference .empty p{font-size:11px}.reference .empty img{width:45px;height:45px}.create-form{gap:9px}.style-grid{gap:5px}.style-choice{font-size:11px;min-height:34px;padding:7px 2px}.privacy{font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}textarea{font-size:13px;padding:10px}.viewer .top,.viewer .bottom{padding:12px}.viewer .bottom{gap:6px}.viewer button{font-size:12px;padding:7px 10px}.empty{gap:8px}.empty img{width:50px;height:50px}.empty h2{font-size:20px}.empty p{font-size:12px}.job-art{width:66px;height:66px}.ring{width:48px;height:48px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
